edges.reason: holderMint uses msg.sender both to prove star ownership and as the mint recipient.
whitelistMint derives the Merkle leaf from msg.sender and mints to msg.sender.
tieredWhitelistMint derives the Merkle leaf from msg.sender and mints to msg.sender.
publicMint mints directly to the untrusted msg.sender.
withdraw sends the entire balance to msg.sender after an owner check.
holderMint performs an external call to starContract.ownerOf for each star id.
holderMint reads and writes usedStarIds to prevent double minting.
holderMint increments holderMintedAmount by _ids.length.
holderMint requires _ids.length to stay within maxBatchAmount.
holderMint calls _safeMint for the holder.
_safeMint invokes onERC721Received on contract recipients, allowing reentrancy.
_safeMint delegates receiver checking to _checkOnERC721Received.
_safeMint writes the first owner entry into the _owners mapping.
_safeMint advances the currentIndex supply counter.
whitelistMint calls _safeMint for the proven address.
whitelistMint marks mintedWhitelist[msg.sender] to block repeat mints.
whitelistMint increments whitelistMintedAmount by _num_tokens.
whitelistMint verifies the proof against whitelistRoot.
whitelistMint multiplies _num_tokens by whitelistMintPrice to check msg.value.
tieredWhitelistMint calls _safeMint for the proven address.
tieredWhitelistMint verifies the proof against tieredWhitelistRoot.
tieredWhitelistMint increments whitelistMintedAmount by _num_tokens.
publicMint calls _safeMint for the caller.
publicMint queries totalSupply before minting.
publicMint enforces the maxSupply cap using totalSupply.
publicMint multiplies publicMintPrice by _num_tokens to validate msg.value.
publicMint enforces publicMaxPerTransaction.
publicMint increments publicMintedAmount by _num_tokens.
publicMint sets startingIndexBlock from block.number when supply is exhausted.
adminMint calls _safeMint to the specified address.
adminMint increments adminMintedAmount by _num_tokens.
adminMint enforces the maxBatchAmount limit.
totalSupply adds holderMintedAmount into the sum.
totalSupply adds adminMintedAmount into the sum.
totalSupply adds whitelistMintedAmount into the sum.
totalSupply adds publicMintedAmount into the sum.
finalizeStartingIndex derives startingIndex from blockhash and block.number.
finalizeStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock to pick the entropy block.
finalizeStartingIndex takes modulo maxSupply of the blockhash.
withdraw performs an ether transfer to msg.sender.
withdraw reads the contract balance into the local variable.
withdraw sends funds to the untrusted msg.sender address.
setStarContract assigns the starContract state variable.
setPublicMintPrice assigns publicMintPrice.
setBaseURI assigns baseURI.
holderMint performs arithmetic on mint counters and matchStarComp offsets.
publicMint performs arithmetic on supply and price values.
_transfer rewrites _owners entries including the tokenId+1 slot.
_transfer computes tokenId+1 and balance increments/decrements.
_checkOnERC721Received makes the external onERC721Received call to the recipient.

normalization_plan.reason: The _ids array parameter only feeds holderMint's ownership loop and mint count, so it folds into the holderMint function node.
The whitelist Merkle proof parameter is used solely inside whitelistMint, so it merges into that function node.
The _num_tokens parameter of whitelistMint only parameterizes that function's mint and payment logic.
The _to recipient parameter exists only to direct adminMint's mint target.
The _num_tokens parameter of adminMint is consumed entirely inside adminMint.
The _price parameter is only assigned to publicMintPrice within setPublicMintPrice.
The _newBaseURI parameter is only assigned to baseURI within setBaseURI.
The balance local is computed and immediately spent inside withdraw before the transfer.
